_note: Pattern overlays for every species. art: drawn by pet-part.pattern.<id>, one group per part (data-on body / head), each clipped to that part; vars: CSS variables the pattern sets (socks colour the feet, chest colours the chest, points colour ears, paws and tail tip); color: the slot the pattern is drawn in, which the description names. es / g: noun and its gender-number for the screen-reader description (m, f, mp, fp), e.g. 'con manchas blancas'.
